excerpt: Download Kurozu: AI Health Context by YIFAN WU on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Kurozu: AI Health Context.
content_html:
Build timeline context for AI

Free · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Build local-first timelines for AI-facing health context. Kurozu helps you build a local-first timeline of health context specifically for enhancing communication with AI. Start locally without an account. Add facts with precise, approximate, or timeless dates. When you choose to sign in, cloud timelines can sync through your account. Optional Apple Health preview features read selected Health data on device to generate temporary local-only summaries based on timeline facts. Export feature builds an AI-facing prompt in plain text so you can paste your context wherever you choose. Kurozu is for personal information management. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

为 AI 构建时间线上下文

免费 · 专为 iPad 设计。 未针对 macOS 进行验证。

为面向人工智能的健康环境建立本地优先的时间表。 Kurozu 帮助您建立本地优先的健康背景时间表，专门用于加强与人工智能的沟通。 无需帐户即可在本地启动。 添加带有精确、近似或永恒日期的事实。 当您选择登录时，云时间线可以通过您的帐户同步。 可选的 Apple Health 预览功能会读取设备上选定的健康数据，以根据时间线事实生成临时的本地摘要。 导出功能以纯文本形式构建面向 AI 的提示，以便您可以将上下文粘贴到您选择的任何位置。 Kurozu 用于个人信息管理。 这不是医疗建议、诊断或治疗。
